title: Israel begins ground operation in southern Lebanon
body:
On 30 September and 1 October 2024 the Israeli military began what it called limited incursions into southern Lebanon, days after an airstrike killed Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah. The military said it was targeting Hezbollah sites posing an immediate threat to northern Israeli communities. Political and security officials approved commando ground raids on Hezbollah targets and infrastructure in southern Lebanese villages, supported by air force and artillery units.

An Israeli military spokesperson asked residents of several southern Lebanese villages to evacuate north of the Awali River, and Israel closed off the area around three towns near the border. An anonymous Israeli security official said operations were concentrated on villages near the border and that a ground incursion into Beirut was "not on the table." Israeli officials described the goal as a buffer zone pushing Hezbollah back from the border.

Lebanon's Health Ministry reported more than 1,000 people killed in Israeli strikes across Lebanon in under two weeks, many of them civilians. Israeli authorities said about 63,000 Israelis remained displaced from the border area because of Hezbollah rocket fire, and the United Nations said about one million Lebanese had been displaced by Israeli airstrikes. Hezbollah deputy leader Naim Kassem said the resistance forces were ready for a ground engagement. A White House official said the US supported the incursion but warned Israel about "mission creep."
